row:
Hi I'm Ryan! Welcome to my life!

This channel is a collection of DIY, life in country Australia and life as a chiropractor in a hospital and medical centre setting. In the Life of Ryan, follow me on some of my hobbies and DIY projects around our house in Orange. 

I enjoy learning how to build and design things. Come along a journey with me as I figure out how to make it work!
